```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

# Instalamos biomaRt para descargar secuencias y Biostrings para el análisis de motivos
BiocManager::install(c("Biostrings", "biomaRt"))
BiocManager::install("BSgenome.Athaliana.TAIR.TAIR9")
```

```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)
library(BSgenome.Athaliana.TAIR.TAIR9)

# ==============================================================================
# PASO 1: Obtener las coordenadas del TSS con biomaRt
# ==============================================================================

genes_target <- c("AT5G11260", "AT3G17609", "AT2G20570", "AT5G44190")
nombres_genes <- c("HY5", "HYH", "GLK1", "GLK2")

message("Conectando con Ensembl Plants para extraer coordenadas...")
mart <- useMart("plants_mart", dataset = "athaliana_eg_gene", host = "https://plants.ensembl.org")

coord_df <- getBM(
  attributes = c("tair_locus", "chromosome_name", "strand", "transcript_start", "transcript_end"),
  filters = "tair_locus",
  values = genes_target,
  mart = mart
)

coord_df <- coord_df %>%
  group_by(tair_locus) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculamos la ventana (-1000 a +100) y adaptamos el formato para BSgenome
coord_df <- coord_df %>%
  mutate(
    TSS = ifelse(strand == 1, transcript_start, transcript_end),
    start_window = ifelse(strand == 1, TSS - 1000, TSS - 99),
    end_window   = ifelse(strand == 1, TSS + 99, TSS + 1000),
    gene_name    = nombres_genes[match(tair_locus, genes_target)],
    
    # Adaptación CRUCIAL: Ensembl devuelve cromosomas como "1", "2"... 
    # pero BSgenome los necesita como "Chr1", "Chr2"...
    chr_bsg      = paste0("Chr", chromosome_name),
    
    # Adaptación de la hebra: de 1/-1 a +/-
    strand_bsg   = ifelse(strand == 1, "+", "-")
  )


# ==============================================================================
# PASO 2: Extraer secuencias usando el genoma local (BSgenome)
# ==============================================================================

message("Extrayendo secuencias locales con BSgenome...")

# La función getSeq es inteligente: si le pasas strand = "-", extrae el reverso complementario.
promotores_seq <- getSeq(BSgenome.Athaliana.TAIR.TAIR9,
                         names  = coord_df$chr_bsg,
                         start  = coord_df$start_window,
                         end    = coord_df$end_window,
                         strand = coord_df$strand_bsg)

# Nombramos las secuencias para que los resultados sean legibles
names(promotores_seq) <- coord_df$gene_name


# ==============================================================================
# PASO 3: Definir el motivo de LEC1 y escanear
# ==============================================================================

motivo_consenso <- "CCAAT"

buscar_sitios_union <- function(seqs, motivo) {
  resultados <- data.frame()
  
  for (nombre_gen in names(seqs)) {
    secuencia <- seqs[[nombre_gen]]
    
    # Búsqueda en la Hebra Forward (+)
    matches_fwd <- matchPattern(motivo, secuencia, max.mismatch = 0)
    if (length(matches_fwd) > 0) {
      resultados <- rbind(resultados, data.frame(
        Gen = nombre_gen, Strand = "+", Start = start(matches_fwd), 
        End = end(matches_fwd), Sequence = as.character(matches_fwd)
      ))
    }
    
    # Búsqueda en la Hebra Reverse (-)
    motivo_rev_comp <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAString(motivo)))
    matches_rev <- matchPattern(motivo_rev_comp, secuencia, max.mismatch = 0)
    if (length(matches_rev) > 0) {
      resultados <- rbind(resultados, data.frame(
        Gen = nombre_gen, Strand = "-", Start = start(matches_rev), 
        End = end(matches_rev), Sequence = as.character(reverseComplement(matches_rev))
      ))
    }
  }
  return(resultados)
}

tabla_resultados <- buscar_sitios_union(promotores_seq, motivo_consenso)


# ==============================================================================
# PASO 4: Interpretar y exportar
# ==============================================================================

print("Sitios de unión candidatos encontrados (-1000 a +100):")
print(tabla_resultados)

write.csv(tabla_resultados, "Resultados_Promotores_LEC1_TFM.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
